title: The Well of Vessel Farm
author: S. M. Sterling
blurb: Oscar Vasquez, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
